title: E011 pre-run counts and freeze: byte copies (cut at the last newline) of surprise_live alerts.jsonl, outcomes.jsonl, passes.jsonl into e011_analysis/inputs/; PRE_RUN.json (outcome-blind counts) and FREEZE_MANIFEST.json; enforces the 7 sha256 pins; refuses (exit 75) before 2026-11-11T13:00Z
expected_value: the frozen, sha-recorded inputs the single registered E011 analysis reads (the collector keeps appending to the live files), plus the outcome-blind pre-run counts the code-version ruling requires
next_action: q0791 and q0792 start; nothing to commit yet
notes: Light (< 500 MB; surprise_live was 47 MB on 2026-10-19). The wrapper builds inputs.partial-<UTC> and renames it to inputs/ only when complete, so a failed attempt leaves no inputs/ (a stray inputs.partial-* is moved aside, never removed, before a retry). It exits 75 before 13:00Z (retry later) and 2 on a pin mismatch, a modified tracked file other than docs/research_lab/trials.jsonl, or an existing inputs/. Pre-run counts (PRE_RUN.json) read only: line counts; passes.jsonl status and written_utc; alert lines' type, capture_t, evidence_role and fee_category. No outcome line is parsed; the window alert lines with fee_category 'unknown' and the non-ok passes are counted, not interpreted. DRAFT, not in queue/jobs. Promote (git mv to jobs/, commit, scripts/oracle/deploy.sh) only after feat/e011-analysis is merged into the branch the host runs and deployed, so the host HEAD contains scripts/run_e011_analysis.py and the 7 pinned files equal their pins. Runbook: docs/research_lab/E011_ANALYSIS_RUNBOOK_2026-10-30.md. Blinding: until the result exists nobody opens an alert/outcome line, result or log value; counts and sha256s only. Exit 75 if outcomes.jsonl or passes.jsonl was modified <10 min ago or /tmp/arepo_collector.lock is held (quiescence).
